Each villa has roughly 300 m² of living space, 4 m ceilings and a third-floor lounge with a home cinema; the villas look out over the ocean, rice fields and volcanoes. Handover is planned for Q3 2026 on a 30-year leasehold with an extension option. Based on the Blackpoint agency.

Completion is expected in Q3 2027 on a 50-year leasehold. Based on the Blackpoint agency.

Villas measure 127–138 m² on 105–122 m² plots; each has its own entrance, private pool, terrace, garden and water filtration system, with architecture based on the Balinese Tri Angga principle. Handover is planned for Q1 2027 on a leasehold running to August 2058 with an extension option. Based on the Blackpoint agency and balivillarealty.com.

Комплекс занимает более 8 000 м², около 37% территории — парк со старыми тиковыми деревьями; предусмотрены ресторан, спа, бассейн, амфитеатр и парковка, а пешеходная дорожка связывает его с соседним проектом Bingin Villas. Апартаменты выходят на океан, сад, рассвет или закат; сдача — 4 квартал 2029 года, права — лизхолд на 30 лет с двумя продлениями по 25 лет. Сведения — по данным агентства Blackpoint.
research.text_en: Bingin Resort is a 52-apartment boutique hotel in Bingin on the Bukit, a few minutes from Bingin and Dreamland beaches. The site covers more than 8,000 m², about 37% of it a park with old teak trees, and includes a restaurant, spa, pool, amphitheatre and parking; a footpath connects it with the neighbouring Bingin Villas project. Apartments face the ocean, garden, sunrise or sunset; handover is planned for Q4 2029 on a 30-year leasehold with two 25-year extensions. Based on the Blackpoint agency.

Цена — €140 000 без мебели и €150 000 с мебелью; сдача — сентябрь 2026 года, права — лизхолд до 1 сентября 2048 года с возможностью продления на 25 лет. Сведения — по данным агентства Blackpoint.
research.text_en: Can Ulu is four detached two-level one-bedroom villas in a jungle setting in Uluwatu, 3 minutes from Thomas Beach and 5 minutes from Suluban and Padang Padang. Each 79.9 m² villa has a living room, kitchen, guest WC and storeroom downstairs and a bedroom with bathroom upstairs, plus a private pool, garden, terrace and parking space. Prices are €140,000 unfurnished and €150,000 furnished; handover is set for September 2026 on a leasehold to 1 September 2048 with a 25-year extension option. Based on the Blackpoint agency.

research.text_en: Desa Harmonis 2 is a project of 25 one-bedroom villas of about 75 m² in Pecatu (Uluwatu), on Jalan Tegal Sari, 300–400 m from the ocean. The villas have triangular thatched roofs, while shared areas use bamboo architecture and natural ventilation; facilities include a restaurant and bar, two pools, a kids' pool, a garden and 24/7 staff. Completion is set for July 2026 on a 25-year leasehold with a further 25-year extension option. Based on rumavi.com and the Blackpoint agency.

research.text_en: Kerobokan Residence is a small complex in Kerobokan Kelod, about five minutes from Seminyak beach.
